analyst_view.overall: A bottom-of-the-table meeting: Udinese are 19th with 6 points and still without a home win, Fiorentina 16th with 9 after a 3-0 defeat at Monza, so both badly need the points. Udinese's new coach Paolo Zanetti (Runjaic has left) got his first point in a 1-1 draw at Bologna, but striker Keinan Davis is doubtful again with an adductor relapse, Bertola and Idrissa Gueye are out and Ebosse is racing to be fit; Karlstrom is one booking from a ban. Fiorentina coach Vanoli has sent the squad into a training camp from Thursday and Florence reports say this game is decisive for his job, with a switch back to a more cautious 4-3-3 expected. Fiorentina's defence is short: Pongracic and Parisi are out and Viery is in serious doubt after going off injured at Monza, leaving Ranieri and Dragusin in the middle. None of these absences are in the numbers' missing list; they already count only recent form (more shots, fewer cards) and the head-to-head, and no referee was named yet.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.9 goals, already lifted a little for Fiorentina's recent scoring, Udinese leaking goals and past meetings. Both defences are among the three worst in Serie A and Fiorentina are missing Pongracic and probably Viery, which the numbers don't know, but Udinese may lose Davis, their main striker, with Bayo or Zaniolo up front instead. With a nervous relegation game and Vanoli expected to go back to a safer 4-3-3, I lean mildly lower, to about 2.8.

corners.text: The numbers expect 9.3 corners and already add a little for both teams winning more corners than usual lately. Fiorentina's change from 4-2-3-1 to 4-3-3 with Njie wide and Udinese's wing-backs like Abankwah both keep play going down the flanks, and nothing I read points clearly either way, so I stay at about 9.3.

cards.text: The numbers say 3.8 cards, already pulled down because both sides, Udinese especially, have picked up fewer cards than expected in their last six games. This is a tense six-pointer at the bottom with Fiorentina's coach reportedly playing for his job and the squad in a training camp, which tends to bring more fouls and protests, and Karlstrom and Dragusin are both one booking from a ban. The referee is not yet named; I lean a little higher, to about 4.0.

shots.text: The numbers expect 29.8 shots and already push them up strongly for recent form: Udinese and especially Fiorentina have been shooting more than expected, and both have allowed plenty. Davis being doubtful takes away Udinese's main target, while Fiorentina's weakened back line should let Udinese shoot more; these roughly balance, so I stay at about 30.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 9.9 shots on target, already raised a lot for recent form (Fiorentina +15%, Udinese +7%). Without Davis, Udinese's striker, their attempts are more likely to be from distance and off target, and Fiorentina's more cautious set-up could mean fewer clear chances, so I lean slightly lower, to about 9.6.
